properties.name: shenyu.register.enabled
properties.description: Enable business-client registration. False skips all client registration validation and resources.

properties.name: shenyu.register.register-type
properties.description: Client registration repository SPI name. Built-in business-client transport is http; custom SPI formats remain extension-owned.

properties.name: shenyu.register.server-lists
properties.description: For HTTP, nonempty comma-separated absolute HTTP/HTTPS Admin URLs. No built-in default.

properties.name: shenyu.namespace
properties.description: Semicolon-separated namespace IDs. Missing or wholly blank uses existing default 649330b6-c2d7-4edc-be8e-8a54df9eb385; nonblank lists require nonblank entries.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.shutdownWaitTime
properties.description: Existing shutdown-hook delay in milliseconds, integer 0..2147483647. Preserve this case-sensitive Properties key.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.delayOtherHooksExecTime
properties.description: Existing shutdown-hook takeover window in milliseconds, integer 0..2147483647. Preserve this case-sensitive Properties key.

properties.name: shenyu.client.http.props.appName
properties.description: Application identity. HTTP legacy falls back to spring.application.name when blank; opt-in falls back only when appName is absent. Other built-in listeners accept appName or contextPath.

properties.name: shenyu.client.http.props.contextPath
properties.description: Gateway registration prefix; it need not be the backend servlet context path. HTTP legacy defaults to /<spring.application.name>; opt-in defaults to empty.

properties.name: shenyu.client.http.props.host
properties.description: Advertised host or existing interface selection input; omission retains host discovery. TARS requires a host.

properties.name: shenyu.client.http.props.port
properties.description: Advertised port. HTTP/WebSocket allow omission, -1 or 0 for deferred automatic discovery; other explicit ports must be 1..65535. gRPC, SOFA and TARS require a port. This property does not configure server.port.

properties.name: shenyu.client.http.props.isFull
properties.description: Existing HTTP/WebSocket full-context registration option. Defaults to false.

properties.name: shenyu.client.http.props.addPrefixed
properties.description: Existing addPrefixed flag; retain the exact camel-case Properties key. Defaults to false.

properties.name: shenyu.client.websocket.props.contextPath
properties.description: Gateway registration prefix; it need not be the backend servlet context path. HTTP legacy defaults to /<spring.application.name>; opt-in defaults to empty.

properties.name: shenyu.client.websocket.props.host

properties.name: shenyu.client.websocket.props.port
properties.description: Advertised port. HTTP/WebSocket allow omission, -1 or 0 for deferred automatic discovery; other explicit ports must be 1..65535. gRPC, SOFA and TARS require a port. This property does not configure server.port.

properties.name: shenyu.client.websocket.props.isFull
properties.description: Existing HTTP/WebSocket full-context registration option. Defaults to false.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.enable
properties.description: Enable binding of client discovery configuration. Defaults to false.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.register
properties.description: Enable the supported client-side instance registration path. Defaults to false.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.type
properties.description: Existing discovery SPI type. Local publication uses local by default; active discovery paths require an explicit type.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.server-list
properties.description: Discovery provider address list. Active remote instance providers require their server address; custom formats remain provider-owned.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.props.sessionTimeout
properties.description: ZooKeeper session timeout in milliseconds. Validated only for the active matching client-side discovery provider; retain exact Properties key casing.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.props.connectionTimeout
properties.description: ZooKeeper connection timeout in milliseconds. Validated only for the active matching client-side discovery provider; retain exact Properties key casing.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.props.baseSleepTime
properties.description: ZooKeeper retry base sleep in milliseconds. Validated only for the active matching client-side discovery provider; retain exact Properties key casing.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.props.maxRetries
properties.description: ZooKeeper instance registration retry count, not HTTP failback retries. Validated only for the active matching client-side discovery provider; retain exact Properties key casing.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.props.maxSleepTime
properties.description: ZooKeeper retry maximum sleep in milliseconds. Validated only for the active matching client-side discovery provider; retain exact Properties key casing.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.props.etcdTimeout
properties.description: Etcd timeout in milliseconds; nonnegative Java long. Validated only for the active matching client-side discovery provider; retain exact Properties key casing.

properties.name: shenyu.discovery.props.etcdTTL
properties.description: Etcd lease TTL in seconds; positive Java long. Validated only for the active matching client-side discovery provider; retain exact Properties key casing.

properties.name: shenyu.client.http.props.protocol
properties.description: Existing advertised protocol prefix. Its consumer retains protocol semantics; this startup gate does not introduce a closed extension scheme allowlist.

properties.name: shenyu.client.websocket.props.protocol
properties.description: Existing advertised protocol prefix. Its consumer retains protocol semantics; this startup gate does not introduce a closed extension scheme allowlist.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.username
properties.description: Existing HTTP Admin login user.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.password
properties.description: Existing HTTP Admin login secret. Never put real credentials in examples or diagnostic output.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.aes-secret-key
properties.description: Existing optional HTTP password-encryption key; preserve this hyphenated Properties key. Crypto validation remains transport-owned.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.aes-secret-iv
properties.description: Existing optional HTTP password-encryption IV; used with aes-secret-key. Crypto validation remains transport-owned.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.applicationShutdownHooksClassName
properties.description: Existing optional JVM-hook override. Reflection availability is runtime/JDK-specific.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.applicationShutdownHooksFieldName
properties.description: Existing optional JVM-hook field override.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.registrationFencingDomains
properties.description: Existing opt-in fencing domain configuration; see shenyu-register-center/REGISTRATION_FENCING.md. Its capability/ownership validator remains transport-owned.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.registrationFencingStartupId
properties.description: Existing fencing startup UUID override; omitted generates a random startup UUID.

properties.name: shenyu.register.props.registrationFencingExpectedGeneration
properties.description: Existing fencing expected generation; canonical nonnegative long. Validated by the existing fencing implementation.
